footer.privacy: Your data stays on your PC. Simloom does not collect or send any personal data; it only contacts GitHub to check for updates at startup and, when you ask, to download the FM27 plugin.

fm.empty: No squad imported yet. Start FM27 with the plugin, load your save, then click “Import from FM27”.

col.name: Player

an.xiSub: best player in each position, out of 20
an.depthHelp: Natural players in each position. Red: nobody in a key position; amber: only one player.

sum.noMatch: Available with the latest plugin version.

bridge.title: FM27 plugin
bridge.intro: The plugin reads your squad in FM27 (read-only) and hands it to Simloom. Simloom installs and updates it for you.
bridge.gameMissing: fm.exe not found in this folder
bridge.bepinexMissing: BepInEx 6 (IL2CPP) is not installed: the plugin needs it.

bridge.offline: Could not check the latest version (offline?).

tac.noAttributes: Player attributes are needed: import again from FM27.
tac.localRefError: Local reference file unreadable: using built-in reference
tac.suggestedHelp: Placement worked out by Simloom. The plugin can't yet read which player holds each position in your FM27 tactic.
tac.pitchHelp: Eleven picked by fit to the style's roles, injured players left out. Dotted lines show the move from the other phase. Hover a player to see backups.
tac.balanceHelp: Pace, pressing and aerial play are compared to your eleven's average level: green = strength, red = weakness. Each weakness lowers the team rating, which picks the formation and style: the eleven is judged as a whole, not only position by position.

width.title: Width
width.ok: someone provides width on each side

missing.L: no wide role on the left
missing.R: no wide role on the right
missing.both: no wide role on either side

width.tip: Put a wide role (full-back, winger) on that side or use “Play wider”.

creation.title: Creativity
creation.tip: Aim for 2 to 4 creative roles (deep-lying or advanced playmaker…).

cover.title: Cover
cover.tip: Keep a defensive midfielder or a screening role out of possession.

box.title: Box presence
box.tip: Add a role that attacks the box (inside forward, second striker…).

pace.title: Defensive pace
pace.textHigh: {{value}} on average for a high line
pace.tip: Too slow for a high line: drop it a notch.

press.title: Pressing
press.tip: Trigger the press a little less often to last 90 minutes.

aerial.title: Defensive aerial play
aerial.tip: Avoid defending deep against crossing teams.

tac.fromGameHelp: Players and positions read from your FM27 tactic. Roles and instructions: the game's when the plugin reads them, otherwise each player's best role in that position.
tac.suggestedHelpGame: Placement computed by Simloom for the chosen style. “Game XI” shows your real FM27 line-up.
tac.pitchHelpGame: Your FM27 line-up. Dotted lines show movement from the other phase. Hover a player for their substitutes; click a formation on the right to compare with an XI computed by Simloom.
tac.projectBest: Your project is now the best choice

contracts.byYear: Monthly wages freed by contract end year
contracts.soon: Contracts to deal with (18 months or less)

wages.byStatusHelp: Statuses from highest to lowest. A healthy wage bill pays higher statuses more: the average should drop with the status.
wages.overText: {{wage}} per month, more than a typical “{{status}}” ({{ref}})
wages.underText: {{wage}} per month for a “{{status}}”, less than a typical “{{other}}” ({{ref}})
wages.releaseText: {{wage}} per month saved if he leaves
wages.valueHelp: Monthly wage per level point: most expensive first.

fin.unknown: not read by the plugin yet
fin.simHelp: Contracts ending within 12 months. Enter the wage you would offer (0 = let him go): the room is recalculated. Nothing is saved.
fin.effect: Effect on the wage bill: {{delta}} per month
fin.afterUnknown: the room will show once the board budget is known
fin.noBoard: Board expectations (league position, style, youth, finances) are not read by the plugin yet.

loans.none: No loans in the snapshot. The plugin does not read loaned players yet.
loans.help: A young player who doesn't play on loan barely progresses: recall him or find another club next window.

dressing.unknown: not read by the plugin yet
dressing.noMorale: Player morale is not read by the plugin yet. Once it is, you will see who is unhappy and how it affects buy-in to your tactics.
dressing.leadersHelp: Sorted by Leadership then Determination. A leader with low morale weighs on the whole group.

cmp.help: Highlighted: best in the row. The reference role's key attributes are in bold. The list also includes the game's targets when the plugin provides them.

prog.title: Level since {{date}}
prog.snaps_one: 1 snapshot: {{dates}}. Import one at each new game date to see the curves.
prog.snaps_other: {{count}} snapshots: {{dates}}. Import one at each new game date to see the curves.

depth.help: Level today → {{s1}} → {{s2}}. The game hides potential: the projection follows the average age curve (strong up to 22, decline after 30), then the real trend once snapshots are several months apart.
depth.fromTactic: Same style, formation and XI as Tactics > Line-up: change them there and this view follows.
depth.fromGame: XI read from your FM27 tactic (or Simloom's if you pick it in Tactics > Line-up).

cal.help: Two matches 3 days apart or less: rotate the most tired players.
cal.none: The fixture list comes with the latest plugin version. Meanwhile, rotation is based on current condition and sharpness.
cal.rustyHelp: Give them minutes in cup games or late in matches to regain sharpness.

roles.help: Each cell shows the fit for the best {{phase}} role at that position. Pills: natural positions. Grey numbers: out of position (the game adds a familiarity penalty). Dashed circle: out of position but better than at his own, worth a try. Hover a cell to see the role.

how.keys: 70%: the role's key attributes, weighted by importance.
how.base: 20%: the position's basic attributes (for a centre-back: marking, tackling, heading, positioning…).
how.engine: 10%: "match engine" attributes (acceleration, pace, anticipation, decisions), useful everywhere outfield.
how.foot: Stronger foot: on a flank, −0.5 if the foot does not match (−1 if one-footed). Inverted roles want the foot opposite to the flank.

style.whichHelp: Each style's requirements compared with the profile of the 16 best available outfield players. Pick a style for details.
style.profileHelp: Average out of 20. Highlighted: what the selected style needs.
style.rolesHelp: Fit = weighted average of the role's key attributes. Injured players excluded.
style.effHelp: New in FM27: a gauge tells whether the team will carry out your instructions. Simloom estimates it here; the game's real gauges are under "Effectiveness" once the plugin reads them.
style.simplify: Simplify instructions or plan training time.

eff.none: The game's effectiveness gauges are not in this snapshot yet. Meanwhile, Simloom's estimate is under "Playing style".
eff.snapsSub: import every week to track progress

proj.help: Simloom measures the gap between your squad and this style, then derives the positions to sign and each player's work. Natural formations for this style: {{forms}}.
proj.developSub: 23 or younger, close to the level

verdict.step: Gradual switch possible: keep {{rec}} and add instructions from your project.
verdict.no: Not yet: stay with {{rec}} for now.

c.readyHelp: positions at target level (7 of 11 advised)
c.abilityHelp: reading of the game vs. style complexity

proj.eta: With the same squad, a safe switch around {{date}}.
proj.etaNever: With the same squad, the switch does not happen within 3 years: you need to sign players.
proj.tipRecruit_one: Signing speeds everything up: {{count}} more ready position needed to reach 7 of 11.
proj.tipRecruit_other: Signing speeds everything up: {{count}} more ready positions needed to reach 7 of 11.
proj.tipBridge: Bridge style: {{bridge}} is almost as suitable as {{rec}} and closer to your project.
proj.tipGauge: In match, check the game's tactical effectiveness gauge before switching: it has the final say.
proj.switchHelp: Projection: each player progresses along the age curve (or his real trend), attributes shifted accordingly. Ignores departures and signings.
proj.noRecruit: No position to sign at this target level.
proj.recruitAll: For all signings, the style needs: {{list}}.
proj.collectiveMore: Also: team cohesion for buy-in, match preparation for the opposition report.
proj.trainingHelp: Target role: his position's role for a starter in the target XI, otherwise the project role he fits best. Areas: his 3 weakest key attributes for that role, for individual training.

targets.title: Transfer targets · {{style}} {{form}}
targets.help: Your in-game shortlist, ranked by what each player would add to your target XI ("Recruitment and training"): fit for the position's role and gain over the current starter. Click a row to compare.
targets.none: Your in-game shortlist is not in the snapshot yet. Meanwhile, the profiles to look for are under "Recruitment and training".

pi.title: Player instructions
pi.help: Picked from the player's attributes against their own level, position, foot, roles and the style. An instruction the game locks for the role is never suggested.
pi.locks: Locks inferred from the roles (screening, covering, dropping, outlet: pressing locked to “Less often”; pressing roles: “More often”). If you spot another padlock in game, say so and the rule will be extended.
pi.nothing: Nothing to add: the role is enough.
pi.switch: Role {{phase}}: switch from {{from}} to {{to}} to allow “{{what}}”.

why.gkShort: good with his feet, suits short distribution
why.rushOut: good rushing out, useful behind a high line
why.shootLess: weak shot: look for the pass
why.directPass: can find the space in behind

cutInside.LR: left foot on the right side
cutInside.RL: right foot on the left side

why.holdPositionFb: lacks pace and stamina to get forward
why.holdPositionDm: positioning and teamwork: shields the defence
why.roam: movement, vision and flair above their level
why.lateRuns: movement and shooting: good at arriving late
why.tackleLess: weak tackling: avoid fouls and cards

phaseHelp.P: 4 weeks back: P1 and P2 physical only, P3 adds ball work (Wednesday and Saturday friendlies), P4 passing, build-up, attacking and defensive work (Wednesday friendly).
phaseHelp.T: 4-week block to install the tactic, with a Wednesday match.
phaseHelp.A: First 4 months: broad technical and tactical work.
phaseHelp.B: Next 3 months: established organisation, match preparation and team bonding.
phaseHelp.C: To the end: match preparation, defensive organisation and set pieces.

train.title: Training week
train.manual: No calendar in the snapshot: tick the match days (friendlies included).
train.priorities: Areas of your target style worked first: {{list}}.
train.rule1: Day before a match: match preparation. Day after: Recovery, Recovery, then Team Bonding as the extra.
train.rule2: No Rest sessions: Team Bonding is not rest.
train.rule3: If a match moves, put preparation back the day before and recovery the day after.
train.rule4: Players back from international duty are handled separately.
train.rule5: Judge the plan over several weeks, not one result, and lighten it if the workload doesn't suit.
train.source: "Freedom" method (FM Scout, FM27 training schedules): 44 schedules, 4-week themed cycles. The article ships no .fmf files: Archivix rebuilds each day with FM27's sessions, steered by your target style. Copy it into the game's Training screen.
train.trainingDaysHelp: A part-time club only trains on some evenings: tick the days offered in the game's Training screen. Other days without a match stay free; the last session before a match is used for preparation.
train.presetHint: Starting point in the game: load the "{{preset}}" schedule, then adjust the sessions as below.
train.weakest: Least understood areas according to the game (Effectiveness), added to the priorities: {{list}}.
train.rusty: lacking sharpness: reserve minutes or late appearances
train.individualHelp: Role and areas: the project's (his position's role in the target XI, otherwise the role he fits best) and his 3 weakest key attributes, to set as individual training focus. Intensity: set under "Individual Player Intensity"; never very high by default (injury risk).
train.noMentoring: No group to suggest: it needs players aged 21 or under and at least one player aged 24+ with a favourable personality (or high determination). Personality comes from the extended player read.
train.mentoringHelp: In the game: Training, Mentoring, Create Mentoring Group. Influential players' personality and determination rub off on the group's youngsters, for better or worse; at most 3 youngsters per mentor, from the same area of the pitch when possible.
